title: Product Page Content

fields.label: Page sections
fields.name: page_sections
fields.instructions: Add, remove, and reorder sections to build this product's page. Each section type has its own fields (photos/videos, copy, table rows, etc.). The homepage turnstile card (below, separate tab) is independent of this — it's a short summary shown on the homepage, not one of these sections.

sub_fields.label: Headline — muted (soft weight)
sub_fields.name: hero_headline_muted
sub_fields.instructions: Second sentence of the H1, rendered in a visually softer/muted weight for emphasis contrast.
sub_fields.default_value: Built to see depth, not faces.

sub_fields.label: Primary CTA label
sub_fields.name: hero_cta_primary_label
sub_fields.instructions: Scrolls to the comparison section (#comparison) if one exists on this page.

sub_fields.label: Secondary CTA label
sub_fields.name: hero_cta_secondary_label
sub_fields.instructions: Scrolls to the specifications section (#specs) if one exists on this page.

sub_fields.label: Device-stage photo
sub_fields.name: hero_device_photo
sub_fields.instructions: Leave empty to show the honest TODO(photo) placeholder below instead of a stand-in stock photo.

sub_fields.label: Device-stage video
sub_fields.name: hero_device_video
sub_fields.instructions: Optional, takes priority over the photo above.

sub_fields.label: Device-stage placeholder caption
sub_fields.name: hero_device_placeholder_caption
sub_fields.instructions: Shown only when neither the photo nor video above is set.

sub_fields.label: Stat items
sub_fields.name: stat_items
sub_fields.instructions: Border-divided row, 2-4 items work best.

sub_fields.label: Headline
sub_fields.name: how_it_works_headline
sub_fields.default_value: From real depth to a ready dashboard.

sub_fields.label: Steps
sub_fields.name: how_it_works_steps
sub_fields.instructions: Numbered step cards, in order.

sub_fields.label: Visual type
sub_fields.name: step_visual_type
sub_fields.instructions: Controls only the TODO(...) label shown when no real photo/video is uploaded below.

sub_fields.label: Step visual — photo
sub_fields.name: step_visual_photo
sub_fields.instructions: Leave empty to show the honest TODO placeholder.

sub_fields.label: Step visual — video
sub_fields.name: step_visual_video
sub_fields.instructions: Optional, takes priority over the photo above.

sub_fields.label: Step visual placeholder caption
sub_fields.name: step_visual_placeholder_caption
sub_fields.instructions: Shown only when neither the photo nor video above is set.

sub_fields.label: Column A label
sub_fields.name: comparison_column_a_label
sub_fields.instructions: Left comparison column header, e.g. the legacy/competing approach.

sub_fields.label: Column B label
sub_fields.name: comparison_column_b_label
sub_fields.instructions: Right comparison column header, e.g. this product's name — leave blank to default to the product's title.

sub_fields.label: Compliance/trust callout
sub_fields.name: comparison_callout
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. Rendered with a “Read our Privacy Policy” link appended (links to /privacy/).

sub_fields.label: Pending-confirmation note
sub_fields.name: specs_pending_note
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. When set, rendered as a visible on-page flag above the spec grid — must stay honest, not just an admin note.

sub_fields.label: Draft (unconfirmed)
sub_fields.name: is_draft
sub_fields.instructions: Shows a “(draft)” tag next to the value when checked.

sub_fields.label: Chips
sub_fields.name: use_case_chips
sub_fields.instructions: Short use-case labels, rendered as a chip strip.

sub_fields.label: Capabilities line label
sub_fields.name: use_cases_capabilities_label
sub_fields.instructions: e.g. “One sensor, three capabilities:” — leave blank to hide the whole capabilities line.

sub_fields.label: Headline
sub_fields.name: final_cta_headline
sub_fields.default_value: See it on your own floor plan.

sub_fields.label: Button label
sub_fields.name: final_cta_button_label
sub_fields.instructions: Links to /contact/.

fields.label: Teaser photo
fields.name: teaser_photo
fields.instructions: Leave empty to show the honest TODO(photo) placeholder.

fields.label: Teaser video
fields.name: teaser_video
fields.instructions: Optional, takes priority over the photo above.

fields.label: Link label
fields.name: teaser_link_label
fields.instructions: The whole turnstile card links to this product's page regardless — this is just the visible link text.

description: Restructured 2026-07-31 (see NOTES.md, "Products turnstile + per-product pages") from a fixed 7-tab layout into a Flexible Content field (“Page sections”) with 7 reusable section types (Hero, Stat Strip, How It Works, Comparison Table, Specifications, Use Cases, Final CTA) so editors can add/remove/reorder a product's page sections in wp-admin. Rendered by single-product.php (/products/{slug}/). The separate “Homepage Turnstile Card” tab (7 fields, unchanged keys from the field group's original 2026-07-30 version) feeds the homepage's “Meet our products” turnstile card for this product — independent of the page sections above.
